stem: Why doesn't the narrator watch the other turtles hatch at the end of the story?

options.label: A
options.text: He is consumed by his thoughts about the first turtle's destiny.

options.label: B
options.text: He doesn't have the patience to observe such a long process.

options.label: C
options.text: He is concerned that his mother has started worrying again.

options.label: D
options.text: He doesn't want to ruin the experience for the little girl.
